sheet.template: Photorealistic model-agency casting digitals sheet of one single woman, {age} years old with a genuinely youthful face, {traits}. Strikingly beautiful, fresh and approachable, the kind of face that works for young and older audiences alike. Four tall panels side by side in one row, the same woman in every panel, against a plain light-grey studio wall: panel 1 front headshot with a relaxed neutral expression; panel 2 front headshot with a warm genuine smile; panel 3 side profile headshot; panel 4 full-body front view standing naturally. Identical outfit in every panel: fitted plain white t-shirt, straight light-blue jeans, white minimal sneakers, small gold hoop earrings. Hair and makeup as described, kept fresh and light, soft even daylight, natural real skin texture with a fresh youthful glow, consistent identity across panels, professional and tasteful.

swim_elegant.template: A single photograph, not a collage. Full-body photo of the same woman as in the reference sheet: identical face, hair, skin tone and body. She stands at the edge of the infinity pool of a newly built luxury Mediterranean villa at golden hour: white lime walls, travertine deck, olive trees, the sea in the distance. Elegant look: a refined high-waisted bikini in plain sand beige with an open sheer white linen shirt over it, small gold hoop earrings, barefoot. She presents the pool to the camera with one open palm, relaxed natural posture, warm genuine smile, looking into the lens. Tasteful, elegant real-estate lifestyle editorial, photorealistic, real skin texture.
